So here we have an anomaly that gets around in the sewers and has a particular taste for animal tissue. What a coincidence that we have another SCP that is literally a section of a sewer that is being overtaken by animal tissue. Seems like a controlled use of SCP-153 would make for an easy means of controlling the spread of SCP-2717. Recommending the addition of the following addendum:

Addendum 153-04: A controlled release of SCP-153 instances has been proposed as a potential containment method for stalling the spread of SCP-2717. Approval Pending.

Obviously there are risks in using SCP-153 for this purpose (ie what if one escapes?), hence why the approval for the proposal is still pending.

If anyone has other/better examples that could be used here please leave a comment saying so!

Thirty foot worms in the sewers… joy….
I'm assuming that they have to somehow liquefy their target before they ingest them. Makes it so much worse to imagine, along with the amount of time it takes. 4 black boxes for the number of seconds it takes puts the time of liquefaction at anywhere between 17 minutes and nearly 3 hours. Would probably really suck to walk into the bathroom in the middle of this. On a side note it would make sense that there should be a paralytic otherwise whoever the victim is would just jump out of the tub, especially with a 17 minute feeding time.

Maybe they are attracted to people who listen to music while they shower so the screams would be masked by the loud music coupled with the running water? Then again that seems too silly.
Despite its problems I shall upvote.
